name: nexus-desktop
description: Private local Nexus task-planning workflow for ChatGPT Desktop and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan substantive work with local capability evidence.
interface.longDescription: Nexus is a private, local planning plugin. It uses the existing read/plan-only Nexus Runtime R2 MCP server, exposes no remote endpoint, and never grants execution authority.
